completion:
Note the time Serious incident or injury occurs and the Time Foreman was notified.
3. These times should not be rounded.
4. Submit an Incident Report verbally within 2 hours serios incident or injury.
5. Complete an Initial Report **within 24 hours** of the verbal Incident Report.
6. Ensure all questions (no blank lines) are answered thoroughly; failure to complete all questions can result in a resubmittal.
7. Be specific in the Narrative.
8. Use the initial team in the narrative.
9. Provide a factual sequence of events.
10. Avoid stating "not our fault" or incriminating enough to be in an appeal.
11. Time Must be noted in 24-hour format and documented by the date, month year (06/04/2024).
12. Next Day Issues with motor vehicle accidents, beam
